description: Assign a language to text, to paragraph or character styles, or to the document or application defaults (the application default applies to new documents: the default language dictionary), so the right spelling and hyphenation dictionaries and quotation marks are used; optionally set the Duden hyphenation style (Character panel > Language)

hyphenationStyle.description: Duden hyphenation style for the text, paragraph styles or defaults

language.description: Language name as InDesign shows it, such as "English: USA" or "German: 2006 Reform"

target.description: Where to apply it; give one or more

defaults.description: The active document's text defaults, or the application's (used with no document open and for new documents)

name: apply_language
title: Apply Language
